name: CITYCENTRE
summary: CITYCENTRE is Houston's premier open-air lifestyle destination featuring upscale shopping, fine dining, and live entertainment in a contemporary mixed-use environment. With its walkable plaza design, weekend live music, and curated mix of brand-name stores and chef-driven restaurants, it serves as a sophisticated social hub for the Memorial area.
demographics: CITYCENTRE attracts an affluent, educated demographic primarily consisting of young professionals and families aged 25-54 with household incomes exceeding $100,000. The trade area draws from Houston's Memorial and Energy Corridor neighborhoods, appealing to upwardly mobile consumers seeking premium shopping and dining experiences. Visitors typically exhibit sophisticated tastes, favoring experiential retail, chef-driven restaurants, and lifestyle amenities over traditional mall shopping. The center serves as a social hub for the area's professional class who value walkability, outdoor gathering spaces, and curated retail offerings.
description: CITYCENTRE stands as Houston's premier mixed-use lifestyle destination, seamlessly blending upscale shopping, fine dining, and entertainment in a contemporary open-air environment. Developed by Houston-based Midway, a real estate firm with over 50 years of experience creating distinctive properties, this sophisticated center has transformed the Memorial area into a vibrant urban village. The property features brand-name retailers alongside chef-driven restaurants and inviting outdoor patios, creating an atmosphere that encourages visitors to linger and explore. Live music performances enliven the plaza on weekends, while innovative entertainment options like Sandbox VR provide cutting-edge experiences for tech-savvy visitors. With its walkable design, public art installations including works like "Flowers for mom" by Dual and pieces by Melissa Borrell, and carefully curated tenant mix spanning shopping, dining, living, and working spaces, CITYCENTRE has established itself as more than just a shopping center—it's a complete lifestyle destination that reflects the sophistication and energy of modern Houston.
